Definition: from G3491 and G2819 ("clerk"); a captain:--owner of a ship.
BiblicalUsage: The centurion believes the master and the owner of the ship more than the things Paul speaks, and the voyage ends in wreck.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is a warning about whose voice I trust at sea: the owner has a ship to save, but the prisoner has God's word, and the ship was lost because the wrong voice was believed.
